title: Trump says Musk has restored Ukraine's access after Starlink row
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that Elon Musk has restored full Starlink internet access to Ukraine following a period of restricted speeds that hindered military operations. While President Volodymyr Zelensky noted that full service had not yet been completely recovered as of Thursday, reports suggest a private conversation between Trump and Musk led to the lifting of these connectivity limits. This situation highlights the critical dependence of the Ukrainian military on Musk's satellite technology for battlefield communications and drone operations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ኢሎን ማስክ የዩክሬን የስታርሊንክ ኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ መመለሱን አረጋግጠዋል። በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሮ የነበረው የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነት መገደብ፣ በትራምፕ እና በማስክ መካከል በተደረገ ውይይት እንደተፈታ ይነገራል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ አገልግሎቱ ገና ሙሉ በሙሉ አልተመለሰም ቢሉም፣ ይህ ክስተት የዩክሬን ጦር ለጦር ሜዳ ግንኙነት እና ለድሮን ስራዎች በስታርሊንክ ቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጥገኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp, Elon Maaski tajaajila interneetii Staarlinkii kan Yuukreeniif deebisee guutuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Dhibbaan ariitii interneetii kun tarkaanfii waraana Yuukreen irratti gufuu ta'ee kan ture yoo ta'u, marii Traampii fi Maaski gidduutti godhame kanaan akka furame himama. Pireezidaanti Vooloodiimiir Zelenski tajaajilli sun ammayyuu guutummaatti hin deebine jedhanii ibsanillee, taateen kun waraanni Yuukreen qunnamtii dirree waraanaa fi hojii dooniiwwan (drones) isaanii geggeessuuf teeknoolojii Staarlinkii irratti hangam akka hirkatan agarsiisa.

title: Ecuador opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez arrested in campaign finance probe
english: Luisa Gonzalez, an Ecuadorian opposition leader and former presidential candidate, was arrested on charges related to illegal campaign financing during her 2023 election bid. Authorities suspect that about $500,000 was moved through an unauthorized network of entities to hide the true source of campaign funds. Gonzalez and her political movement have denied these allegations, labeling the arrest as a form of political persecution by the current government.
amharic: የኢኳዶር የተቃዋሚ መሪ እና የቀድሞ የፕሬዚዳንት እጩ ሉዊሳ ጎንዛሌዝ እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ወቅት በተፈጸመ የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ታሰሩ። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ ዶላር የገንዘብ ምንጩን ለመደበቅ ባልተፈቀደ መንገድ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል። ጎንዛሌዝ እና የፖለቲካ ድርጅታቸው ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ እስሩ በአሁኑ መንግስት የተቃጣባቸው የፖለቲካ አድማ ነው ሲሉ ኮንነዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun mormituu Ikuwaadoor fi dursee dorgomtuun pireezidaantummaa duraanii Luwiisaa Goonzaaleez, xalayaa filannoo ishee kan bara 2023 irratti shakkii seeraan alaa maallaqa fayyadamuu irratti to'ataman. Abbootiin alangaa akka jedhanitti, qarshiin gara kuma 500 ta'u maddasaa dhoksuuf jecha karaa seeraan alaa ta'een akka socho'e shakkameera. Goonzaaleez fi dhaabbanni siyaasaa ishee himannicha haaluun, hidhichi mootummaa amma jiruun siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffatee kan gaggeeffame akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Michigan voters closely divided between Rogers and El-Sayed
english: As the midterm elections approach, voters in Michigan remain split between Republican candidate Mike Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed for the U.S. Senate seat. Recent campaign activities highlight the tight competition between the two contenders. Some voters have raised personal questions regarding the candidates during public events, reflecting the intense atmosphere of this race.

oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa waggaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, filattoonni Michigan teessoo Mana Maree Senetii Amerikaatiif giddutti kan dorgoman Mike Rogers kan paartii Rippabilikaanii fi Abdul El-Sayed kan paartii Dimookiraataatii gidduutti qooddamaniru. title: What is the history behind Trump’s LeBron blast over US national anthem?
english: President Donald Trump recently criticized NBA star LeBron James for continuing his pre-game warm-ups during the playing of the national anthem. Trump labeled the athlete a disgrace and demanded an apology, citing a lack of respect for American heroes. This incident is the latest in a long-standing history of public friction between the two figures, who have frequently traded political criticisms over the years.

title: Magnitude 7 earthquake kills 16 people in China’s Tibet, Xinhua reports
english: A powerful magnitude 7 earthquake struck China's Tibet region, resulting in at least 16 deaths and 32 injuries. Emergency teams have launched a level-II response as many residents fled their homes for safety due to structural damage. This event marks the most intense seismic activity recorded in China since the beginning of 2024.
amharic: በቻይና ቲቤት ግዛት በተከሰተ የ7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 32 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ፈጣን ምላሽ እየሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም በቤቶቻቸው ላይ በደረሰው ጉዳት ምክንያት ወደ ውጭ በመውጣት ላይ ናቸው። ይህ አደጋ ከፈረንጆቹ 2024 መጀመሪያ ወዲህ በቻይና የተከሰተው ከፍተኛው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ነው።

Godinicha keessatti hojiin gargaarsa hatattamaa jalqabamee kan jiru yoo ta’u, manneen hedduun waan diigamaniif namoonni naannichaa gara alaatti bahuuf dirqamaniiru. Kun sochiin lafaa hanga kanaa Chaayinaa keessatti bara 2024 jalqabee mudate isa jalqabaati.

title: Report: UN to end Gaza entry coordination as Israel arrests returnees
english: The United Nations plans to stop managing the entry of Palestinians returning to Gaza from Egypt starting in mid-November due to ongoing security concerns and frequent arrests by Israeli forces. This decision follows recent incidents where individuals, including medical patients, were detained at the Rafah crossing. The UN intends to withdraw from this role regardless of whether a replacement organization is found, though they will continue to assist with medical evacuations.

title: First Arab-American mayor to endorse Trump becomes adviser to president
english: Amer Ghalib, the former mayor of Hamtramck, Michigan, has been appointed as President Trump’s advisor for Arab-American affairs. Ghalib, who gained national attention as the first Arab and Muslim official to endorse Trump in 2024, will serve as a direct liaison between the White House and the community. Although his previous nomination as ambassador to Kuwait was blocked by the Senate due to past social media comments, he will now provide informal policy advice to the President.
amharic: የሃምትራምክ፣ ሚቺጋን የቀድሞ ከንቲባ አሜር ጋሊብ፣ የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የአረብ-አሜሪካ ጉዳዮች አማካሪ ሆነው ተሹመዋል። በ2024 ለትራምፕ ድጋፋቸውን የሰጡ የመጀመሪያው አረብ እና ሙስሊም ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ጋሊብ፣ በዋይት ሀውስ እና በአረብ-አሜሪካዊያን ማህበረሰብ መካከል እንደ ድልድይ ሆነው ያገለግላሉ። ቀደም ሲል ለኩዌት አምባሳደርነት ታጭተው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በሴኔቱ ያልተፈቀደላቸው ጋሊብ፣ አሁን በፕሬዚዳንቱ ስር በመመካከር ስራ ላይ እንደሚሰማሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kantiibaan duraanii magaalaa Hamtramck, Michigan, Ameer Gaalib, gorsaa dhimmoota Arabaa-Ameerikaa kan pirezidaant Traamp ta'uun muudamaniiru. Gaalib, namicha jalqabaa mootummaa Arabaa fi Muslimaa kan bara 2024 Traamp deeggare, gara fuulduraatti hidhata White House fi hawaasa Arabaa gidduutti bakka bu'uun hojjetu. Kanaan dura bakka bu'aa mootummaa Kuwait ta'uuf carraaqqii godhanis seeneetiin waan mormameef, amma ammoo pirezidaantichaaf gorsa kennuuf murteeffataniiru.

title: Egypt calls for Yemen talks as parliament weighs military support to Saudi Arabia
english: Egypt is advocating for diplomatic solutions to the conflict in Yemen while its parliament considers whether to authorize military support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi forces. Lawmakers have delayed the final vote until late October to allow for further discussion on the matter. Egyptian officials have also traveled to Riyadh to consult with Saudi leadership regarding the potential military involvement.

title: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
english: Becky Drury, a teacher at an Oregon elementary school, recently revealed that she survived a tragic shooting by playing dead after being severely injured by a 16-year-old gunman. The attacker killed three students and another teacher before being stopped by a parent who fatally shot him. Drury clarified that she was unable to protect her students because she was shot immediately while trying to secure her classroom door.
amharic: በኦሪገን አንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት መምህር የሆኑት ቤኪ ድሩሪ፣ የ16 ዓመት ታዳጊ ተማሪ በከፈተው ተኩስ በጠና ከቆሰሉ በኋላ፣ በህይወት ለመትረፍ እንደሞቱ በማስመሰል ማምለጣቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጥቃት አድራሹ ሶስት ተማሪዎችን እና አንድ መምህር ከገደለ በኋላ፣ በቦታው የነበረ አንድ ወላጅ ተኳሹን በመግደል ህይወቱን አጥፍቷል። መምህርት ድሩሪ የክፍሏን በር ለመዝጋት ሲሞክሩ በጥይት ስለተመቱ ተማሪዎቻቸውን መከላከል እንዳልቻሉ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Barsiistuun mana barnoota sadarkaa tokkoffaa Ooregoniitti argamu tokko, ijoollee fi barsiisaa biraa ajjeesee kan ture dargaggeessa waggaa 16 irratti erga rukutameen booda, duute of fakkeessuun lubbuushee akka oolchite ibsite. Balaa kanaan ijoolleen sadii fi barsiistuun tokko kan du’an yoo ta’u, kanneen balaa kana dhaabes abbaan ijoollee achi ture tokko waraana dhukaasee ajjeechaa raawwataa sana erga ajjeeseen booda. Barsiistuun kun balbala kutaa barnootaa cufuuf yommuu yaaltu waraana waan ishee rukuteef, barattootashee oolchuuf carraa akka hin argatin ibsite.

title: Carney and Erdogan launch ‘strong and resilient’ Canada-Turkiye partnership
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan have established a new strategic partnership to boost economic and security cooperation. This three-year initiative aims to finalize a free trade agreement while focusing on key sectors like defense, energy, and artificial intelligence. The two nations hope to significantly increase their bilateral trade volume as Canada seeks to diversify its international partnerships.

oromo: Mummichi ministeera Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii fi pireezidantiin Turkii Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan guddina dinagdee fi nageenyaa waliin hojjechuuf waligaltee tarsiimawaa haaraa mallatteessaniiru. Kaanaadaan hirkattummaa ishee kan Ameerikaa irraa hir'isuuf akka biyyaatti, biyyoonni lameen daldala gidduu isaanii jiru guddifachuuf murteessaniiru.

title: Netanyahu promises Iran regime change: Can Israel topple Tehran government?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that replacing Iran's current leadership is his main goal, though he faces skepticism regarding his ability to achieve this. While experts agree that Israel possesses the military capacity to carry out significant airstrikes, they note that the country lacks a viable strategy to fully overthrow the regime. Furthermore, it remains unclear if the United States would support such a campaign or commit to a large-scale conflict that could destabilize the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የኢራንን መንግስት መለወጥ ዋና ግባቸው እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ይህንን ግብ ለማሳካት የሚያስችል አቅም እንደሌላቸው በብዙዎች ዘንድ ጥርጣሬ ተጥሎባቸዋል። እስራኤል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት የመፈጸም ወታደራዊ አቅም ቢኖራትም፣ የኢራንን አስተዳደር ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማፍረስ የሚያስችል ግልጽ ስልት እንደሌላት ባለሙያዎች ያስረዳሉ። በተጨማሪም፣ አሜሪካ እንደዚህ ያለውን ዘመቻ ለመደገፍ ወይም ለሰፊ ጦርነት ለመዘጋጀት ያላት ፍላጎት እርግጠኛ አይደለም።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu mootummaa Iraan fonqolchuun kaayyoo isaanii isa guddaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, kana raawwachuuf dandeettii qaban irratti shakkiin guddaan jira. Israa'el miidhaa guddaa geessisuuf humna waraanaa kan qabdu ta'us, mootummaa Iraan guutummaatti kuffisuuf tarsiimoo ifaa ta'e akka hin qabne ogeeyyiin ni ibsu. Kana malees, Ameerikaan duula akkasii kana akka deeggartu ykn walitti bu'iinsa guddaa kana keessatti hirmaachuuf fedhii akka qabdu ifa miti.

title: Germany arrests Ukrainian man accused of spying for Russia
english: German authorities have arrested a Ukrainian national suspected of spying for Russia since July 2025. The man is accused of collecting sensitive information on military production, personnel, and defensive installations. This development follows a recent increase in the threat level for Russian sabotage against German military facilities due to a series of unexplained drone incidents.

oromo: Mootummaan Jarman lammii Yukireen tokko bara 2025 irraa jalqabee Raashiyaaf haxxummaan akka sassaabu shakkamee qabameera. title: FIFA’s Infantino made to wait on Asian support as chief coy at AFC session
english: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has not yet committed its support for Gianni Infantino's upcoming FIFA presidential bid. As Infantino seeks a fourth term, the 47 AFC member nations hold significant sway, with current opinions among them remaining divided. AFC President Sheikh Salman stated the organization is remaining neutral for now, despite earlier criticism of Infantino’s leadership.
amharic: የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ለጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በቀጣዩ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ የሚኖረውን ድጋፍ እስካሁን በይፋ አልገለጸም። ኢንፋንቲኖ ለስድስተኛ ጊዜ ለስልጣን በሚወዳደሩበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የ47ቱ የእስያ አገራት ድምፅ ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖረዋል። የኮንፌዴሬሽኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ሼክ ሳልማን ድርጅታቸው በአሁኑ ሰዓት ገለልተኛ መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ አባል አገራቱ ግን በተለያዩ አቋሞች ተከፋፍለዋል።

Infantino yeroo afuraffaaf aangoo barbaadaa jiru kanatti, biyyoonni miseensa AFC 47 ta'an sagalee murteessaa qabu, ta'us yaanni miseensota gidduutti wal qabataa miti. Pireezidaantiin AFC Sheikh Salman akka jedhanitti, dhaabbatichi hanga ammaatti bakka tokkollee hin dhaabanne, akkasumas yaada garee kanaa ilaalchisee yaanni garaagaraa jiraachuu eeraniiru.

title: Tsadkan’s “Reforms” Have Fragmented Tigray’s Unity
english: The political campaign led by General Tsadkan Gebretensae and his allies to weaken the TPLF has fractured Tigray's internal unity rather than solving the region's humanitarian crisis. By aligning with federal forces to dismantle existing political institutions, this faction has deepened regional divisions and renewed old internal grievances. Instead of achieving the stability promised by the Pretoria Agreement, these actions have left the people of Tigray struggling with ongoing trauma and a lack of recovery.
amharic: ጄኔራል ጻድቃን ገብረትንሣኤ እና አጋሮቻቸው የህወሓትን ስልጣን ለመገዳደር የጀመሩት እንቅስቃሴ በትግራይ ህዝብ መካከል መከፋፈልን እንጂ የመፍትሄ ሃሳብ አላመጣም። እነዚህ አካላት ከፌዴራል መንግስት ጋር በመተባበር የክልሉን ነባር ተቋማት ለማዳከም መሞከራቸው የቆዩ የውስጥ ቅራኔዎችን በማንሰራራት የክልሉን አንድነት አናግቶታል። የፕሪቶሪያው የሰላም ስምምነት ተስፋ ቢሰጥም፣ ይህ የፖለቲካ ሽኩቻ ለህዝቡ አስፈላጊ የሆነውን ሰላምና መልሶ ማቋቋም ከማገዱም በላይ የህዝቡን ስቃይ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Duulli siyaasaa kan jeneraal Tsadqaan Gabratinsa'eefi degartootasaatiin durfamu, kan laaftuu TPLF laaffisuuf yaadame, tokkummaa naannoo Tigraay kan cimsineefii mannaa qooddeera. Gareen kun humnoota federaalaa wajjin hiriiruun jaarmiyaalee siyaasaa naannichaa diiguuf yaaluunsaanii, mufiiwwan durii fi wal dhabdee keessa deebi'ee akka uumamu godheera. Waliigalteen nagaa Preetoriyaa abdii gaarii kan fide ta'us, dorgommii siyaasaa kanatu nagaa fi misooma ummataa gufuu ta'ee, rakkina sabichaa caalaatti hammaachiiseera.

title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
english: In the upcoming Israeli election, Arab parties are positioned as potential kingmakers as the race remains deadlocked between opposing coalitions. Many Arab citizens are highly motivated to vote this time to challenge the current hard-line government, despite facing increased social tension and discrimination since the October 7 attacks. While major Jewish political blocs have historically hesitated to form alliances with Arab parties, the lack of a clear majority may force them to reconsider these partnerships to secure power.

oromo: Filannoo Israaʼel dhufuuf jiru keessatti, partileen Arabaa mormitoota jidduu qixa taʼuun murteessitoota taʼuu dandaʼu. Lammiileen Arabaa hedduun, haala siyaasaa cimaa ammaa dura dhaabachuuf filannoo irratti hirmaachuuf fedhii guddaa qabu. Partileen Yihuudotaa gurguddoon partilee Arabaa waliin hojjechuu yoo irra deddeebiʼanii didan iyyuu, mooraa siyaasaa keessatti injifannoo argachuuf marii gaggeessuun dirqama taʼuu dandaʼa.

title: Celebrity shark guided out of South Korea canal refuses to swim out to sea
english: A famous dusky shark named Bukangi, which became a local celebrity in the South Korean city of Busan, is refusing to leave a canal despite a lengthy rescue effort. After authorities spent hours guiding the shark toward the open sea, the animal repeatedly circled back and even broke through barriers to return to the waterway. Experts believe the shark may be attracted to the canal due to warmer water temperatures and a steady food supply, though concerns remain regarding its health.
amharic: ቡካንጊ የተባለችው ታዋቂ የሻርክ ዓሣ በደቡብ ኮሪያዋ ቡሳን ከተማ የሚገኝ ቦይ ለቅቃ ወደ ባህር ለመሄድ ፈቃደኛ አልሆነችም። ባለሥልጣናት የሻርክ ዓሣዋን ወደ ሰፊው ባህር ለመመለስ ለረጅም ሰዓታት ጥረት ቢያደርጉም፣ እንስሳቷ በተደጋጋሚ ወደ ቦዩ እየተመለሰች ትገኛለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚሉት የውኃው ሙቀት መጨመርና የምግብ መኖር ዓሣዋን ወደ ቦዩ እንደሳባት ቢገመትም፣ ስለ ጤንነቷ አሳሳቢ ሁኔታዎች አሁንም አሉ።
oromo: Qirixxiin (shark) beekamtii argate kan Bukangi jedhamu, magaalaa Busaan kan Koriyaa Kibbaa keessatti toora bishaanii keessatti hafeera. Ogeeyyonni qirixxiicha gara galaanaatti deebisuuf sa'aatii dheeraaf carraaqqii godhanis, inni garuu irra deddeebi'ee gara toora bishaanii sanatti deebi'aa jira. title: Two killed in attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
english: An attack at King Fahd International Airport in eastern Saudi Arabia resulted in two deaths and eight injuries among various nationalities. While officials have not specified the method of the attack, it follows a series of drone and missile strikes in the region often attributed to Houthi rebels. The incident is part of an escalating conflict involving cross-border hostilities between Saudi-led forces and Houthi fighters.

title: El Salvador's president threatens Haitian gangs over military hostages
english: El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has launched a military rescue operation to save four air force members kidnapped by armed gangs in Haiti. President Bukele has issued a stern warning to the captors, promising severe consequences if the individuals are not returned unharmed.

oromo: Pirezedaantiin El Salvaadoor Nayib Bukele miseensota humna qilleensaa afur garee hidhattootaa Hayitii keessatti butaman bilisa baasuuf duula waraanaa jalqabaniiru. Miseensonni kun kanneen mootummoota gamtoomaniin hayyamamee nageenya eegsisuuf bobbaafaman yoo ta'u, midhaan bituuf deemanii osoo jiranii akka butaman ibsameera. Pirezedaantiin kun hidhattootatti akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsuun, namoonni kun miidhaa malee yoo gadhiifaman malee tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Michigan Senate debate: Key takeaways from El-Sayed, Rogers clash
english: Michigan Senate candidates Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers held their final debate ahead of the upcoming midterm elections, focusing on issues like trade, foreign policy, and the economy. Rogers discussed the impact of tariffs on Michigan’s automotive industry, while El-Sayed criticized his opponent's stance on the conflict with Iran. The outcome of this race is critical, as it will help determine which party gains control of the U.S. Senate.
amharic: የሚቺጋን የሴኔት እጩዎች የሆኑት አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ እና ማይክ ሮጀርስ በመጪው የሴኔት ምርጫ ዙሪያ የመጨረሻ ክርክራቸውን አድርገዋል። በክርክሩም የንግድ ታሪፍ፣ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ እና የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ዋና ዋና አጀንዳዎች ነበሩ። እጩዎቹ በተለይም ስለ ሚቺጋን አውቶሞቢል ኢንዱስትሪ እና ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግጭት ያላቸውን አቋም አንጸባርቀዋል። የዚህ ምርጫ ውጤት የትኛው ፓርቲ የሴኔቱን የበላይነት እንደሚቆጣጠር የሚወስን በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Hirmaatonni filannoo senetii Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed fi Mike Rogers, filannoo dhufu dura falmii isaanii dhumaa gaggeeffataniiru. Falmichaanis dhimmoota akka gibira daldalaa, siyaasa alaa fi diinagdee irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Rogers dhiibbaa gibirri industirii konkolaataa Michigan irratti qabu irratti kan mari'ate yoo ta'u, El-Sayed ammoo falmataa isaa waraana Iraan irratti qabu irratti komii kaaseera. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa paartiin kam seeneetii akka to'atu murteessuuf waan gargaaruuf, xiyyeeffannoo guddaa argateera.

title: Brazil’s president appeals to undecided voters ahead of run-off
english: As Brazil’s presidential election heads into a decisive final round, candidates Lula and Bolsonaro are aggressively campaigning to win over the 30 million people who did not participate in the first round. Both leaders are focusing their efforts on persuading these undecided or abstaining voters in key regions. This final push is critical as the candidates compete to secure the presidency in the upcoming Sunday vote.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ወደ ወሳኙ የመጨረሻ ዙር እየተቃረበ ባለበት ወቅት፣ እጩዎቹ ሉላ እና ቦልሶናሮ በመጀመሪያው ዙር ድምፅ ያልሰጡትን 30 ሚሊዮን መራጮች ለማሳመን ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ሁለቱም መሪዎች በአስፈላጊ ወረዳዎች ውስጥ ያሉትን እነዚህን አሻሚ ወይም ድምፅ ያልሰጡ መራጮች ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ትኩረት ሰጥተዋል። እሁድ በሚካሄደው የመጨረሻ ምርጫ አሸናፊውን ለመለየት ይህ የመጨረሻ የቅስቀሳ ሂደት ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantummaa biyya Brazil gara maroo dhumaa murteessaa ta'eetti yeroo ce'utti, kaadhimamtoonni Lula fi Bolsonaro namoota miliyoona 30 filannoo jalqabaa irratti hirmaachuu hin dandeenye of biratti hiriirsuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Hogganoonni lamaanuu naannolee murteessaa ta'an keessatti namoota sagalee hin kennine kana amansiisuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennaniiru. Qophiin kun guyyaa Dilbataa filannoo dhufuuf jiru irratti eenyu akka mo'atu murteessuuf baay'ee barbaachisaadha.

title: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
english: Major global websites and government services have been taken offline to address critical security vulnerabilities discovered in the PHP programming language. These severe flaws, identified by artificial intelligence, pose a significant threat as they could allow unauthorized access to sensitive server data. International agencies are advising organizations to either apply the emergency security update immediately or suspend their websites until the risks are fully mitigated.
amharic: በ PHP የፕሮግራም አወጣጥ ቋንቋ ላይ በተገኙ አደገኛ የደህንነት ጉድለቶች ምክንያት በርካታ አለም አቀፍ ድረ-ገጾች እና የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች ተቋርጠዋል። በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተገኙት እነዚህ ከባድ ችግሮች፣ ጠላፊዎች ወደ አገልጋይ ፋይሎች እና ዳታቤዞች በቀላሉ እንዲገቡ ሊያደርጉ ስለሚችሉ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። የሳይበር ደህንነት ተቋማት ድርጅቶች አስቸኳይ የደህንነት ማሻሻያዎችን እንዲያደርጉ ወይም ችግሩ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ድረ-ገጾቻቸውን እንዲዘጉ እያሳሰቡ ነው።
oromo: Hojiin dhimmoota internetii fi websayitoota biyyoolessaa hedduun, rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa afaan sagantaa PHP keessatti argamee hordofee addaan citeera. Rakkoon kun kan argame gargaarsa 'Artificial Intelligence' tiin yoo ta'u, namoonni seeraan ala odeeffannoo dhokataa serverii irraa akka hatan waan taasisuuf balaa guddaa dha. Dhaabbileen nageenya sayibarii addunyaa guutuu, qaamoleen internetii akkaataa suphamaa hatattamaa kana akka fudhatanii fi yoo hin danda'amne ammoo websayitoota isaanii yeroof akka cufan gorsa kennaa jiru.

title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
english: Researchers recently used artificial intelligence to discover a severe, long-standing security vulnerability in the PHP programming language, which powers a significant portion of the internet. Because this flaw allows hackers to potentially take control of web servers and steal sensitive information, governments and major organizations have been forced to take sites offline or install emergency patches. Experts warn that millions of websites are at risk, making this one of the most critical security alerts in recent memory.
amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በቅርቡ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም በ PHP ፕሮግራሚንግ ቋንቋ ውስጥ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲያገለግል የቆየ ከባድ የደህንነት ጉድለት አግኝተዋል። ይህ ክፍተት ጠላፊዎች የድር አገልጋዮችን ተቆጣጥረው ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን እንዳይሰርቁ ስጋት ስለፈጠረ፣ መንግስታት እና ዋና ዋና ተቋማት ድረ-ገጾቻቸውን እንዲዘጉ ወይም አስቸኳይ ማስተካከያዎችን እንዲያደርጉ ተገደዋል። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ድረ-ገጾች ለአደጋ የተጋለጡ በመሆናቸው፣ ይህ ጉዳይ በቅርብ ጊዜ ውስጥ ከተከሰቱት እጅግ አደገኛ የሳይበር ደህንነት ስጋቶች አንዱ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Qorattoonni yeroo dhihoo asii fayyadamni 'artificial intelligence' koodii PHP jedhamu keessatti rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa fi yeroo dheeraaf ture akka jiru ifoomsuu danda'aniiru. Rakkoon kun buttonni interneetii qabachuu fi odeeffannoo dhokataa hatuu akka danda'aniif karaa banuudhaan, mootummoonni fi dhaabbileen gurguddoon marsariitiiwwan isaanii yeroof akka cufan ykn furmaata ariifataa akka fudhatan dirqisiiseera. Marsariitiiwwan miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman balaa kanaaf saaxilamuu isaanii kan ibsu ta'uun, kunis rakkoo nageenyaa interneetii yeroo dhihoo asitti mudate keessaa isa cimaa ta'uu himameera.

title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
english: The United States has instructed non-essential government employees and their families to exit Saudi Arabia due to an increase in Houthi militant attacks. Hostilities from the Iran-backed group have targeted civilian infrastructure, including airports and oil facilities, leading to several deaths and injuries. The State Department issued this directive out of concern that the ongoing violence could worsen rapidly.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ አሜሪካ አስፈላጊ ያልሆኑ የመንግስት ሰራተኞቿ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዛለች። ኢራን የምትደግፋቸው ታጣቂዎች በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች፣ በአየር ማረፊያዎች እና በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ በፈጸሙት ጥቃት የሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል፤ ሌሎችም ቆስለዋል። የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ግጭቱ በፍጥነት ሊባባስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Huutii kan gara Iranitti qabatu miidhaa isaa gadi jabeessuun hordofee, mootummaan Ameerikaa hojjettoota mootummaa kanneen dirqama idilee hin qabne fi maatiin isaanii Sa'udii Arabiyaa akka gadhiisan ajajee jira. Haleellaa gareen kun buufata xiyyaaraa fi iddoowwan damee boba'aa irratti raawwataniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miidhaanis ga'eera. Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Ameerikaa akka jedhetti, tarkiinichi kan fudhatame waraanni kun saffisaan hammatuufi soda jiruufi.

title: El-Sayed in face-off against rival Rogers for Michigan Senate seat
english: Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers recently participated in their final debate for an open US Senate seat in Michigan. During the event, the candidates were asked to share their perspectives on whether Iran represents a significant threat to American national security. This debate served as a key opportunity for the two rivals to present their platforms to voters before the election.
amharic: የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ እና የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲው ማይክ ሮጀርስ በሚቺጋን ክፍት የዩኤስ ሴኔት መቀመጫ ላይ ለመወዳደር በመጨረሻው ክርክር ተሳትፈዋል። በክርክሩ ወቅት እጩዎቹ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ትፈጥራለች ወይ በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም እንዲገልጹ ተጠይቀዋል። ይህ ክርክር ሁለቱ ተቀናቃኞች ከመምረጣቸው በፊት ለምርጫው የሚያቀርቡትን ዕቅድ ለሕዝብ ለማስተዋወቅ ትልቅ ዕድል ፈጥሮላቸዋል።
oromo: Hirmaattonni paartii Dimokiraatawaa Abdul El-Sayed fi paartii Rippabilikaanaa Maayik Rojars kursiifi mana maree senetii Miishigan irratti dorgomuuf falmii isaanii isa dhumaa geggeessaniiru. Falmii kana irratti, dorgomtoonni kunniin Iran nageenya biyyoolessaa Ameerikaa irratti balaa qabaachuu ishee ilaalchisee yaada isaanii akka ibsan gaafatamaniiru. Falmiin kun dorgomtoota lamaan kun sagalee kennitootaatti dhiyaachuu fi yaada isaanii ifatti ibsachuuf carraa guddaa ta'eera.

title: North Korea to resume propaganda broadcasts, South Korea urges dialogue
english: North Korea plans to restart anti-South Korea propaganda broadcasts along their border, further escalating tensions after a recent landmine incident injured South Korean soldiers. Kim Yo Jong warned of harsh consequences and announced that new military measures are being prepared at the frontier. Meanwhile, South Korea has officially called for direct talks to prevent accidental military clashes, despite the North refusing to engage in dialogue.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በደቡብ ኮሪያ ድንበር ላይ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስርጭቶችን እንደገና ለመጀመር ማቀዷን አስታውቃለች፤ ይህም በቅርቡ በተከሰተው የማዕድን ፍንዳታ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። የሰሜን ኮሪያዋ ባለስልጣን ኪም ዮ ጆንግ በድንበሩ ላይ አዳዲስ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እንደሚወሰዱ በማስጠንቀቅ ለደቡብ ኮሪያ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደቡብ ኮሪያ ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ ግጭት ለመከላከል እንዲቻል በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ውይይት እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Koreeaan Kaabaa daangaa ishee fi Koreeaan Kibbaa gidduutti duula sagantaa propagandaa ishee ammas itti fufuuf qophii gochuu ishee beeksisteetti. Kunis walitti bu'iinsa uumamee ture kan ammas dabalate yoo ta'u, qondaalti biyyattii Kim Yo Jong tarkaanfii waraanaa haaraa fudhachuu akka malu akeekkachiisteetti. Gama biraatiin, Koreeaan Kibbaa walitti bu'iinsa tasaa ta'e hambisuuf mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti akka taasifamu gaafatteetti.

title: Brazil’s Bolsonaro challenges Lula to expand release of personal records
english: Ahead of Brazil's upcoming presidential runoff, candidates Flavio Bolsonaro and President Lula have engaged in a dispute over the disclosure of personal financial and communication records. Lula initially offered to release his private data if Bolsonaro did the same, leading Bolsonaro to demand that the president also include records from his staff and children. Lula has reportedly agreed to these expanded terms, aiming to clear his name amidst ongoing corruption investigations involving both political camps.

oromo: Filannoo prezidaantummaa Birazil kan itti aanuuf qophiirra jirru kanatti, dorgomtoonni Flavio Bolsonaro fi Prezidaant Lula ragaalee dhuunfaa isaanii ifa gochuurratti wal mormaniiru. Lula ragaalee dhuunfaa isaa ifa gochuuf fedhii kan agarsiise yoo ta'u, Bolsonaro garuu ragaaleen gorsitoota prezidaantichaa fi ijoollee isaa akka dabalaman gaafateera. Prezidaant Lulaan, himannaa malaammaltummaa gam lamaanuu irratti banamee jiru keessatti iftoomina uumuuf jecha, gaaffii Bolsonaro kana fudhateera.

title: Australian TV reporter rescues man from sinking car
english: While covering the severe flooding in Queensland, Australia, a journalist named Will Murray stepped in to help. He and another local resident successfully pulled a man to safety after his vehicle became stuck and started sinking in deep water. Both rescuers acted quickly to save the driver before the situation worsened.

oromo: Gaazexeessaan Awustiraaliyaa tokko Will Murray jedhamu, lolaa naannoo Kuwiinsilaandi keessatti mudate gabaasaa utuu jiruu nama balaa kana keessatti hifate tokko oolcheera. title: Iran's IRGC Navy says seven vessels hit over past day
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy reported that seven ships were damaged in the Persian Gulf region within a single day. Four vessels suspected of smuggling oil were set on fire, while three others struck underwater mines near the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials blamed the United States for these tensions and threatened to target American military bases in the region if the provocations persist.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ኃይል የባህር ኃይል በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ሰባት መርከቦች ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው አስታውቋል። ህገ-ወጥ የነዳጅ ዝውውር ሲያካሂዱ የነበሩ አራት መርከቦች በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል፣ ሶስት መርከቦች ደግሞ ከሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ ፈንጂ በመረገጣቸው ተጎድተዋል። ኢራን ለዚህ ውጥረት አሜሪካን ተጠያቂ በማድረግ፣ ሁኔታው የሚቀጥል ከሆነ በአካባቢው በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Humni Galaanaa kan Eegumsa Islaamaa kan Iraan, guyyaa tokkotti dooniiwwan torba irratti miidhaan ga'uu isaa beeksiseera. title: Gulf exports more oil than it did before Iran war despite surge in Hormuz attacks
english: Oil exports from Gulf countries have reached a record high of 24.6 million barrels per day, exceeding the levels seen before the conflict with Iran began in February. This increase in shipping persists even as Iran continues to conduct frequent attacks on vessels navigating the Strait of Hormuz. Despite the ongoing regional instability and threats of further military action, global oil supply from the region has remained resilient.
amharic: የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት የነዳጅ ምርት ወደ ውጭ የመላክ አቅማቸው በቀን ወደ 24.6 ሚሊዮን በርሜል በማደግ፣ ከየካቲት ወር ግጭት በፊት ከነበረው መጠን በልጧል። ይህ ጭማሪ የታየው ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት መርከቦች ላይ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶችን እያደረሰች ባለችበት ወቅት ነው። በአካባቢው ያለው የፀጥታ ስጋት እና የታቀዱ ጥቃቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ከክልሉ የሚላከው የነዳጅ መጠን መጨመሩ አስገራሚ ሆኗል።

english: Global authorities have issued urgent warnings regarding two critical security vulnerabilities discovered in the widely used PHP programming language. title: LeBron James’s 76ers beat NY Knicks on NBA’s opening night at MSG
english: LeBron James began his 24th NBA season by leading his new team, the Philadelphia 76ers, to a 106-100 victory over the defending champion New York Knicks. The game took place at Madison Square Garden during the Knicks' championship ring ceremony. Tyrese Maxey was the top scorer for the 76ers, while James contributed 14 points and seven assists to spoil the celebration.

oromo: LeBron James yeroo 24ffaaf tapha NBA jalqabeen, garee isaa haaraa Philadelphia 76ers hoogganuun mo'ataa waggaa darbee New York Knicks 106-100 injifateera. title: Italy approves sweeping security measures in response to protests
english: The Italian government has introduced strict security measures, including deploying 500 soldiers to Milan and implementing harsher prison sentences for violent protesters. The new laws also hold parents financially responsible for vandalism committed by their children and expand police authority to detain potentially dangerous teenagers.

title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla exploring largest merger in history
english: Elon Musk has announced that his companies, SpaceX and Tesla, are investigating a potential merger to combine their expertise in artificial intelligence and manufacturing. If the deal proceeds, it would create the largest corporate union in history with a valuation exceeding $3 trillion. However, Musk emphasized that the merger is not guaranteed, as it requires approval from a majority of Tesla shareholders.
